Advanced Reactive Fire: Reactive Attack up to Range 6; dice_shield counts as dice_block for Actions.
Air Alert: Enemy Aircraft in LoS, roll a die: on dice_block friendly vehicles hit on dice_sight too.
Air Assault: Airlifter passenger; may activate after it and dismount with a Move.
Air Traffic Control: Roll a die: on dice_block a friendly Aircraft already activated activates again.
Airborne: Placed anywhere (not within range 2 of an objective) at turn 1. First action Nothing, then a die: dice_block or dice_sight allows a 2nd action, dice_shield another Nothing. No objective capture that turn.
Ammo Supply: Once per game: re-supply all Limited Ammo weapons of friendly ground Units.
And Stay Down: Units hit by its ranged weapons gain a Suppression token.
Artillery Observer: While the radio model lives, may use a friendly unactivated Unit's Artillery.
Assassin: Chooses which enemy Soldiers take Close-Combat hits.
Assault Shield: Equipment of the Unit Leader giving the Assault Shield skill.
Assault Vehicle: Passengers can disembark after the Vehicle has activated this Turn.
At The Double: Free Move Action after a March Move Action.
Berserk: Close-Combat hits: roll again for extra hits on dice_block.
Black Ops: Roll four dice for initiative if your force has this Hero.
Blutkreuz: Zombies within range 1 get Move 3, March 4 and Charge.
Bombing Run: With its listed weapon only, targets four squares and expends all Limited Ammo.
Brave: Roll three dice to remove Under Fire or Suppression tokens.
Charge: Free Close-Combat Attack Action after a March Move Action.
Cheat Death: Once per game, if eliminated roll a die: dice_block or dice_shield, survives Stunned.
Command Squad: Special Actions with Officer, Medic or Mechanic: reactivate, heal, repair, rearm.
Command Vehicle: Mounted Officers, Mechanics and Medics re-roll failed Command Squad actions.
Critical Repairs: Makeshift Repair also removes one Critical Hit effect.
Cultist Command Squad: Officer, Medic or Mechanic Special Actions on Cultist Units.
Cutting: Each hit rerolls: a new hit on dice_block, until a miss.
Damage Resilient: Roll a die per Damage taken; each dice_block negates one point.
Desert Fox: Units reactivated by Rommel gain At The Double for that Activation.
Devour: Each Damage dealt in Close Combat heals this Hero by one Health.
Dozer Blade: Dozer Special Action: Cover Save until the Vehicle moves.
Drive By Shooting: Attack on one side only after a March Move Action.
Engineer Vehicle: Engineering Special Action destroys fortifications and obstacles.
Execute: Special Action: eliminate a soldier of a Stunned Unit within Range 1.
Expert: Weapon hits on dice_block and dice_sight.
Explode: Never a Wreck; if destroyed, units within range 2 are hit by attack_b/1.
Fighting Spirit: Once per game: hits on dice_sight as well as dice_block when attacking.
First Strike: Resolves Close-Combat Attacks before the target does.
Flame: Hit units get a Suppression token and no infantry or cover save.
Flying: Passes over any Terrain as Open Terrain; must end on legal ground.
General: Free Officer Special Action each activation; two dice if joined to an Officer.
Get up, It Ain't That Bad: Medic Special Action: on dice_block or dice_shield, a lost miniature returns or a Hero heals.
Grapple: A hit Stuns: no Move or March, first action Nothing, no Close Combat.
Grenade: Infantry hit keeps its infantry save but gets no cover save.
Helicopter: No Move Action needed first, allowing Sustained Attacks.
High Priest: Get Moving You Monster and Close Wounds on Mythos Creatures.
Infantry Ace: On activation roll a die: dice_block or dice_sight gives a third action.
Interrogate: Eliminating a Hero or Officer in Close Combat: roll four dice for Initiative.
Jammer: Enemy radio Actions within range 6 must be re-rolled.
Killing Spree: Ranged hit: roll another die for another hit on dice_block.
Large Ordnance: Targets a point; 2×2 square explosion (or artillery template).
Laser: Each hit rolls another die: new hit on dice_block, until a miss.
Lesser Mythos Creatures: Never the target of Command Squad, Officer or Medic Special Actions.
Lucky: Once per game, re-roll any dice of an Attack or Sustained Attack.
Master Deceiver: Enemy successful Get Moving rolls must be rerolled while this Hero is in play.
Master Fighter: Hits on dice_sight as well as dice_block with all weapons.
Mechanic Crew: Makeshift Repair: roll one die per Miniature in the Unit.
Medic: Treats wounds and helps exhausted Units recover.
Mindless: Cannot take or hold Objectives (can contest them); immune to Suppression.
Move And Fire: Free Move around a Sustained Attack, or free ranged Attack around a March.
Naval Unit: Treats Water as open Terrain; cannot enter other Terrain.
Nothin's Easy: Joined Unit cannot gain Under Fire or Suppression tokens.
Plasma Gun: Two damage lines: use the one matching the target range.
Poison Master: While on the table, enemies cannot use Get Up, It Ain't That Bad.
Power Scopes: Sustained Attack with ranged weapons hits on dice_sight and dice_block.
Psychic Choir: High Priest's two Special Actions work on Mythos Creatures at a distance.
Psychic Scream: Once per game: Free Action Attack on all Units within Range 3.
Psychic Vortex: Once per game: Free Action Attack on all Units within Range 2.
Quick Recovery: No Nothing Action needed after using Airborne.
Radar: Re-roll failed dice once when attacking an Aircraft.
Radiation: Target must re-roll successful saves; no height advantage.
Rally: Officer Special Action: roll two dice per Unit to remove Under Fire, Suppression or Stunned.
Red Banner: Friendly Infantry within range 2 and in LoS roll three dice when Rallying.
Resurrection: Special Action: each dice_block returns an eliminated zombie within range 1.
Salvo: Normal fire, or a salvo doubling dice and removing the Loaded token.
Savage Animal: Hits on dice_block and dice_sight with the listed weapon.
Scout: March Move in its first Activation gives a third Action.
Smoke Grenades: Once per game, free Special Action: place Smoke on itself.
Smoke Launchers: Once per game, free Special Action: place a Smoke Screen on itself.
Sniper: Ignores cover and infantry saves; the shooter chooses the model hit.
Spotter: If it does not shoot, Sniper weapons on Sustained Attack hit on dice_sight too.
Spy: May stay off the Battlefield, then appear next to an enemy Unit when unmasked.
Squad Support Weapon: Each miniature uses one weapon from the card; the weapon needs one crew.
Stealth: Attacking with this weapon keeps Camouflage.
Tactician: Grants three Pass each Turn, even with more Activations than the enemy.
Take Aim: Sustained Attack: ranged weapons hit on dice_sight as well as dice_block.
Tesla: Damaged unit is Stunned: no fighting, first action Nothing, one reactive die.
Trailer: Acts as a Large Vehicle but occupies three squares.
Volley: Limited ammo: choose how many shots; dice are multiplied.
Way of The Serpent: While on the table, friendly Ninja Units cannot be Suppressed.
Wire-Guided: Attacking with this weapon only: re-roll misses as a Sustained Attack.
Zombie: Passes Infantry Saves on dice_shield as well as dice_block.
